title: 🔥价格大幅偏离持有成本
body: 市场处于深度贴水筑底期。当前价格 $64,469 显著低于 200日定投成本 $72,105，偏离度达 -10.6%。这表明近半年的平均买入者已全线浮亏，上方密集的套牢盘将压制反弹空间。只有价格重新站上成本线，才能确认右侧信号。中性。谁在成本线下吸筹？
title_en: 🔥 Price Massively Diverges from Holding Cost
body_en: The market is deep in a discount bottoming phase. Current price at $64,469 is significantly below the 200-day DCA cost of $72,105, a deviation of -10.6%. This implies the average buyer over the last six months is universally underwater, and the dense trapped supply overhead will cap any rebound. Only a reclaim of the cost line confirms the right-side signal. Neutral. Who is accumulating below the cost line?
